title: Ergama Magaalaa Durii Keessatti
intro: Magaalaa durii dafqaan guutamte, namoonni ishee haaluu keessatti hidda gadi fageeffatanii fi akeekkachiisa dhumaa kan xiyyeeffannaa hin arganne. Har'a gahee warra Rabbiin ergamee ummata mata jabeessa ta'eef ergaa dabarsuu keessa tarkaanfadhaa. Seenaa diduu, sagalee amantii tokkicha, fi xumura labsii gaaga’amaatiin mallatteeffame. Eenyutu karaa ragaalee kanaan dubbata?
clues: Magaalaa ummanni ishee dhugaa irraa garagalee Rabbiin nu erge
Lama keenya dursinee dhufne, achiis inni sadaffaan ergama keenya cimsuuf itti makame
Warri magaalaa nuti akka isaanii nama malee homaa miti jechuun nu didan
Lubbuun tokkichi fixee magaalattii isa fagoo irraa fiigdee ummata nu hordofaa itti himte
Nuti isaan kadhanne, isaan garuu garaa isaanii jabeessanii nutti garagalan
Samii irraa iyya gaddisiisaa tokkoon magaalaan keenya guutuun callifamte

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Ibidda guddaa boba'aa jiru keessatti lubbuun gubate
Qurxummii guddaa galaana gadi fagoo keessa jiruun liqimfame
Utubaa olka'aa ijaaruuf hojii hojjechuuf dirqama
Boolla ibidda cimaa keessatti dararamaa ture

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Gabroomfataa fi waraanni isaa galaana gargar bahe keessatti liqimfame
Ummanni kun gara hantuutaa fi sareetti jijjiirame
Roobni dhagaa samii irraa roobe magaalattii barbadeesse

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
